hub.on: Before the first invoice: give eparagony.pl permission to issue invoices in the KSeF taxpayer app, and switch KSeF on in panel.eparagony.pl. Without both, eparagony.pl refuses the invoice.

deviceNumber.description: Diagnostic only. It is never sent on a receipt - eparagony.pl routes to the device itself. Filling it in lets “Test connection” also report whether the device has been seen alive.
deviceNumber.label: Fiscal device number

fallback.label: Fallback device slot
fallback.notSetOption: Not set - refuse a line with no rate (recommended)
fallback.summaryNotSet: Not set - a line with no rate is refused
fallback.summarySlot: Slot {slot} - used when a line has no rate
fallback.taxRatesNote: What each slot means on your device is the taxRates table, which has no field here - it is device programming rather than a product’s VAT rate. Edit it under “Show raw config JSON” below. Left unset, eparagony.pl assumes the standard Polish slots.
fallback.unrecognised: The saved value ({value}) is not a slot this fiscal device exposes, so saving this connection will be refused until you pick one below.

overrides.description: For testing only. Leave empty so the environment chosen during setup decides the host. Must be https.

paymentForm.description: How the payment is described on the receipt. Only the label is configurable - the amount is always the sale total. Defaults to {default}, the honest description of a prepaid online order.
paymentForm.label: Payment form on the receipt
paymentForm.unrecognised: The saved value ({value}) is not one eparagony.pl accepts, so saving this connection will be refused until you pick one below.

paymentName.description: Optional free text describing the payment - a card scheme or payment provider, for example. Descriptive only.
paymentName.label: Payment name

pollTimeout.description: How long to wait for the fiscal device to finish before the result is recorded as unknown. Defaults to {receiptDefault}. Values outside {min}-{max} are accepted and then brought into that range.
pollTimeout.descriptionWithInvoicing: How long to wait for the fiscal device or the invoicing provider to finish before the result is recorded as unknown. Defaults to {receiptDefault} for e-receipts, {invoicingDefault} for e-invoices. Values outside {min}-{max} are accepted and then brought into that range.
pollTimeout.label: Device wait time (ms)

print.description: Asks eparagony.pl’s print service to also produce a paper receipt. An online sale has no counter and nobody waiting at one, so the default is no paper. “Not set” and “Do not print” produce the same receipt - picking “Do not print” records that it was a decision.
print.label: Paper receipt
print.unrecognised: The saved value ({value}) is not true or false, so saving this connection will be refused until you pick one below.

setupCard.description: Issue Polish fiscal e-receipts on your own printer, invoices, or both.

taxFallback.fieldDescription: Leave this empty. It is only used for an order line that arrives with no tax rate at all, and an empty setting makes OpenLinker refuse such a line instead of guessing.

intendedUse.caveat: A refused registration is a problem you can fix. An issued receipt is not.
intendedUse.term: How it is meant to work
intendedUse.text: The rate belongs to the product, in your shop, and travels with the order line. Leaving this empty is the intended setup: a line with no rate is then refused, with an error naming the order, and you fix the rate in the catalogue.

risk.text: With a slot set, that line is registered at this rate instead of being refused. A fiscal receipt reaches the buyer and your daily report and cannot be recalled, so a wrong slot puts a wrong tax figure on a document you are answerable for.

whatThisIs.text: A slot on your own fiscal device (A to G). It is used for one thing only: an order line that reaches this connection carrying no tax rate. It is you naming your device’s slot - OpenLinker never invents a rate.

whenItFires.caveat: On a standard installation it is off, so this fallback can fire.
whenItFires.text: Only for a line with a blank rate. OpenLinker can refuse those before this connection ever sees them, but that strict check is off unless someone switched it on ({envVar}).

taxFallback.infotipLabel: What the fallback tax rate does, and why it is risky
